linkedin.title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat us like demographics instead of individuals.
linkedin.body:
We have spent years training algorithms to show us more of what we already like. The result is a cycle of confirmation bias that keeps us informed but rarely challenges our perspective. That is not personalization. It is just an echo chamber with better targeting.

The next phase of news technology is not about feeding you more of the same. It is about building a bridge between what you know and what you need to understand. True personalization should act like a skilled editor who knows your interests but also knows when you are missing the full picture.

At Headlinne, our roadmap focuses on context rather than engagement metrics. We are building systems that can synthesize complex topics, strip away the noise, and present the nuance that usually gets lost in a 24-hour news cycle. It is about saving you time while actually increasing your understanding of the world.

Technology should help us see the news more clearly, not just more frequently.

story.title: Russia attacks Zelensky's hometown, Ukraine reaffirms wish to join NATO
story.summary: A Russian ballistic missile attack on President Volodymyr Zelensky’s hometown in central Ukraine on Saturday killed two people and wounded dozens. Hours later, Zelensky reiterated his country's determination to join NATO, following proposals to provide Kyiv with security guarantees similar to those of the military alliance.

story_card.headline: FBI and USDA systems hit by cyberattacks
story_card.standfirst: Major US government departments are dealing with reported security breaches.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The FBI and the USDA were both hacked. The attacks were reported this past Friday.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This is the second time in recent months that the FBI has been targeted by hackers.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The latest FBI breach targeted the National Crime Information Center. This database is used by police.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates on how much data was compromised in these attacks.

story_card.caption:
The FBI and the USDA have been hit by cyberattacks according to reports from multiple news outlets.

This marks the second time in just a few months that the FBI has faced a security breach. The most recent incident specifically targeted the National Crime Information Center, a critical database used by law enforcement agencies across the country.
